title: Average colostrum volume consumed per feed in the first days of life

source.title: Национальная программа оптимизации вскармливания детей первого года жизни в Российской Федерации
source.table: 3.2. Средний объем потребляемого молозива за 1 кормление в первые дни жизни

reviewNotes: The source describes these as average consumed-colostrum ranges, not a universal prescription.

The surrounding text says indicated supplemental feeding should not simply exceed these figures and should be adjusted to weight dynamics; this dataset does not encode that sentence as an automatic dosing rule.
The program separately discusses special supplemental-feeding scenarios and weight loss; those narrative suggestions are not folded into this table.
No general daily-volume formula was identified in this source during the targeted search.
Requires independent transcription verification and rights review before publication/runtime use.
